text:
maria: Quick design review — thinking about regrouping some left nav items. Proposal: put Models + Deployments + Revisions under a single top-level "Serve" section instead of scattered. Also breadcrumb behavior: show the logical path (Serve > Models > MyModel) and keep deep links to panels. Thoughts?
sam: I like grouping. Routing note: we need stable path semantics for deep links. Prefer: /serve/models/:id?panel=logs over hash fragments.
alex: Heads up — changing paths will break existing bookmarks and partner docs. We should provide an alias/redirect table.
jessica: Agreed. We also need telemetry to capture hits on legacy URLs so we can phase the redirects.
oliver: Infra can add a small aliasing layer. Server-side mapping is easiest for SEO/embeds. Need to know exact patterns though.
maria: Accessibility nits: when users expand/collapse groups, ensure aria-expanded updates and focus moves into the first child. Also breadcrumbs should be real nav landmarks for screen readers.
sam: Implementation detail: avoid hash-only routing for deep links (iframes and some SSO flows break). Use history API pushState and canonical path segments. Query params for panel state (e.g., ?panel=metrics) looks cleaner.
alex: Breadcrumb semantics — only show the navigational trail, not UI controls. So: Serve / Models / <Model Name>. Panel tabs should be separate UI crumbs (not part of path).
jessica: Copy nit: prefer label "Serve" (short noun) over "Serving" or "Model Ops". Shortness helps in narrow sidebar.
maria: Quick URL examples to validate: 1) /serve/models/9f2a?panel=overview 2) /serve/deployments/34/logs 3) /serve/models/9f2a?focus=edit&panel=metrics — these should be shareable and restore UI state.
sam: I'll prototype router map. Key constraints: 1) preserve old links via alias table, 2) panels in query, 3) use pushState.
alex: Also we should document permalink contract for customers (we'll publish a migration guide).
jessica: Action items: design mock for regrouping + breadcrumbs by Fri, eng to draft alias table and router PR, infra to support redirects and telemetry tag.
nav-bot: Reminder: design review sync Fri 10:00 AM in #design.
sam: I'll open a draft PR with mapping rules after the sync.
maria: Thanks — will iterate on mock and post a11y checklist here. :thumbsup:
